## Task: Implement header-key lookup pause after successful Redis dispatch

Implement the approved #4569 action-selection change for non-empty header-derived cache keys only. Preserve the existing request-side-effect ordering and fail-open behavior on synchronous dispatch failure, and keep callback ownership unchanged for hit, miss, asynchronous error, and empty-value outcomes.

### Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Immediately before implementation, fetch canonical main, record the exact BASELINE_SHA, confirm the defect still exists, and rerun the all-state duplicate audit
- [ ] Create the implementation branch from BASELINE_SHA and limit production changes to the approved response-cache header-key action-selection path
- [ ] Capture and log the synchronous CheckCacheForKey dispatch error while preserving DisableReroute, Accept-Encoding removal, and DontReadRequestBody ordering on both outcomes
- [ ] Return ActionContinue after synchronous dispatch failure and HeaderStopAllIterationAndWatermark only after successful dispatch
- [ ] Keep the existing callback contract: hit sends one local response without resume; miss, asynchronous error, and empty cached value resume exactly once
- [ ] Update focused regression tests for successful dispatch, synchronous dispatch failure, preserved side effects, hit, miss/error/empty value, empty header, skip-cache, and unchanged body-key behavior without adding a mutable package-global production test seam
- [ ] Run the focused Go test, race, vet, Wasm build, SHA-256, and git diff checks authorized by the verification TASK and record the exact implementation commit
- [ ] Before marking this TASK done, update its canonical summary and checklist with changed paths, exact commands/results, exact commit SHA, decisions, risks, and any non-obvious line-rationale drafts

### Execution Planning

- Owned modules / write areas:
  - plugins/wasm-go/extensions/response-cache/main.go
  - plugins/wasm-go/extensions/response-cache/main_test.go
- Shared touchpoints:
  - plugins/wasm-go/extensions/response-cache/core.go callback contract (read-only unless a maintainer approves a Design amendment)
  - plugins/wasm-go/extensions/response-cache test helpers
- Dependency / interface assumptions:
  - Approved Design #4569 and confirmed SPEC-4568001
  - Current proxy-Wasm header stop and ResumeHttpRequest semantics
  - TASK-4569002 verification inputs and exact-head handoff
- Coupling class: low; one bounded production path plus directly related tests
- Recommended execution mode: one delegated implementation worker after maintainer authorization
- Complexity / split guidance: small; do not split unless current main invalidates the approved scope
